title: Mobility Equipment Records Standard — Days of Use of a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back
content:
# Days of Use of a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back — Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** The days of use of a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash and given back are counted according to its repair history:

1. **When a loaner chair has been delivered for the chair** — from the delivery date to the requested date of its latest return-pickup request (the booking day when it has none), less the days from the requested date to the decision date of its latest repair estimate request (no days when that request has no decision date or the chair has none).
2. **When no loaner chair has been delivered and the chair has a repair estimate request** — from the delivery date to the requested date of its latest repair estimate request, the day its latest fault was reported, so that no use is charged after the chair's latest failure.
3. **Otherwise** — from the delivery date to the decision date of its latest return-pickup request (the booking day when it has none), the day the chair was checked in at the branch.

## Records read

- the delivery date of the chair, on its wheelchair record;
- deliveries in its service history whose purpose is a loaner chair;
- its repair estimate requests — the latest by requested date, with that request's requested date and decision date;
- its return-pickup requests — the latest by requested date, with that request's requested date and decision date.

## Worked examples (hypothetical, chair delivered 1 May, booked 28 May)

| Repair history | Dates on the records | Days of use |
|---|---|---|
| loaner delivered | return requested 25 May; latest repair estimate requested 10 May, decided 14 May | 24 less 4, that is 20 |
| loaner delivered | no return-pickup request; latest repair estimate requested 10 May, not yet decided | 27 (to the booking day), less no days, that is 27 |
| no loaner, repair estimate on file | latest repair estimate requested 10 May | 9 |
| no repair estimate | return-pickup request decided (chair checked in) 20 May | 19 |
| no repair estimate | return-pickup request not yet decided | 27 (to the booking day) |

## Points of judgement

- **Which repair estimate request is used?** The latest by requested date.
- **Which return-pickup request is used?** The latest by requested date: its requested date in the first case, its decision date in the third.
